3.

Facts and circumstances giving rise to present application are that, the marriage of the parties i.e.
son of the applicants and opposite party no.2 was solemnized on 21 November 2017 as per Hindu rituals at MLA Guest House Matiyari Kamta, Lucknow.
It is alleged that after some time of marriage, the complainant realized that she has been cheated.
Her husband had already married before her marriage.

As per his service record, one Nidhi Singh is his legally married wife since 2011,
about which she and her family came to know after the marriage and whenever she questioned her husband and in-laws in this regard, she was beaten and abused.
Her husband has given her name and details as co-applicant in ICICI home loan account without her consent.
They have all her digital documents.
Her husband has forced her many times to take a loan of more than Rs.50,00,000/-.
Her husband has misused her documents at many places.

It is further alleged that at the time of marriage, father of the opposite party no.2- Ram Iqbal Singh (retired army man) has gifted a LED TV, washing machine, fridge, dining table, sofa set, double bed, wooden almirah and 8 gold rings and 3 necklaces, 3 neck chains (about 80 grams of gold) and a silver plate and bowl made of silver and cash of Rs.11,00,000/- and other items were also included and inspite of that a luxury car and cash were repeatedly being demanded from the opposite party no. 2 as additional dowry so that the loan of Rs.50,00,000/- taken by her husband from the bank could be repaid.
Due to non fulfillment of additional demanded dowry, she has been harassed and beaten by her husband and in-laws (applicants).
It is also alleged that her husband has taken about Rs.3,00,000/- from her through internet banking and about Rs.2,00,000/- in cash.
It is further alleged that her husband is alcoholic and after drinking alcohol, he used to abused, forced and beaten her many times.

It is further alleged that on 18 July 2021, when she was in Chinhat, Lucknow, her husband under the influence of alcohol, beaten her badly for not agreeing to the dowry demands and also for not taking her share in the property from her father.

The opposite party no. 2 informed this incident to her brother and father on July 19, 2021, then all the family members of her matrimonial home demanded Rs.10,00,000/- in cash, and if the demand is not fulfilled, they are asked to take their daughter back.

It is further alleged that on 26th July 2021, when her family expressed their inability to do so,
they dragged her by her hair and beaten her with slippers at Mall, Lucknow and also threatened her that if she complained anywhere, she would be given divorce and she would be killed.

It is further alleged that on 17th November 2021, brother and father of the opposite party no.2 gave cash amounting to Rs.10,00,000/- to her husband on demand of in-laws and a settlement was also reached at the family level.
Thereafter, she was taken to Maysoor and kept in a good manner but again she has been maltreated and abused and her husband expressed her desire to live with Nidhi Singh.

It is further alleged that in the month of January 2022, when she was pregnant, her husband abused, tortured and under the influence of alcohol, kicked her on her stomach and tried to kill her and due to which her two months pregnancy was terminated.
After the miscarriage, she was kept confined at Maysoor and threatend to be burnt alive if she complained anywhere.
The opposite party no. 2 informed this incident to her brother and on 08 February 2022, she came to her home in Lucknow from Maysoor.
Her husband and her in-laws are threatening to kill her over the phone.

Regarding which the FIR was lodged on 23.03.2022 at P.S. Chinhat, District Lucknow under Sections 498-A, 504, 323, 506, 313 I.P.C. and Section of D.P. Act Prem Kumar Prasad And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Pursuant to the FIR filed under Sections 498-A, 504, 323, 506, 313 IPC and Section of D.P. Act,
the investigation commenced and the Investigating Officer after concluding the investigation submitted charge-sheet against the applicants and husband on 24.02.2023 under Sections 323, 504,
506,498-A I.P.C. and Section of D. P. Act, which has been culminated into Criminal Case No. 35217 of 2023 arising out of Case Crime No. 228 of 2022, under Sections 498A, 504, 323, 506 I.P.C. and Section of D.P. Act, P.S. Chinhat, District Lucknow.

5 . In these background facts, learned counsel for the applicants has submitted that the marriage of the son of the applicants was solemnized with opposite party no. 2 and due to some dispute between husband and wife, only with the intention to victimize all the family members including the applicants (in-laws), the present FIR was lodged by the opposite party no. 2.

It is further submitted that the applicants who are living separately in Village Bensuar Bujurg, Siwan, Bihar, have been falsely implicated in the present case levelling general allegations against them.
It is further submitted that the Investigating Officer has filed the charge sheet in a mechanical manner upon which cognizance has been taken without application of mind.

6. Further submission is that the ingredients of the offence 'cruelty' is also lacking so far as role of present applicants is concerned and the applicants are father-in-law and mother-in-law and they have been roped in the present case on the basis of omnibus allegations and no any specific instances of their involvement have been disclosed or alleged in the FIR as well as in the charge sheet.

It is further submitted that the applicants are living separately in the State of Bihar and they have nothing to do with the differences of the parties and therefore, the continuation of the criminal proceedings is nothing but an abuse of process of law and court and same may be quashed and set aside.

7. Learned A.G.A. as well as learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 have submitted that, the issue raised in the instant application are disputed question of facts and at this stage, it cannot be considered and therefore, no case is made out to exercise inherent powers of this Court.

8. Having heard the learned counsel for the respective parties and having considered the allegations made in the FIR and charge sheet, the issue arise for my consideration is whether case is made out to quash the criminal proceedings against the applicants, who are in-laws of opposite party no. 2?
9.
It is not in dispute that applicants are residing separately.

So far as role attributable to present applicants is concerned, it is alleged that, the applicants and his son demanded the additional dowry and in non-fulfillment of the said illegal demands opposite party no. 2 is said to have been harassed by the applicants and his son.
Section 498-A of the Indian Penal Code says that whoever being the husband or relative of the husband of a woman, subjects such woman to cruelty, shall be punished.

The term 'cruelty' is explained in the Section, which says that any willful conduct, which is of such a nature, as it likely to drive the woman to commit suicide or to cause grave injury or danger to life,
limb or health of the woman.
10.

In the facts of the present case, the allegations made against the applicants, who are father-in-law and mother-in-law, are extremely general in nature and prima-facie, it appears that Prem Kumar Prasad And Another vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

due to marital discord with the husband, the wife/ respondent no. 2 has filed the FIR implicating the applicants with a view to harass and humiliate them in the society, the allegations against them do not constitute the offence as alleged against them.

Reference can be made to the case of Kahkashan Kausar @ Sonam & Ors. Vs. State of Bihar & Ors. reported in (2022) 6 SCC 599 held and observed that, in recent times, matrimonial litigation in the country has increased significantly which led in an increased tendency to employ provision such as 498A Indian Penal Code as instruments to settled personal scores against the husband and his relatives.

entities.text: Kahkashan Kausar @ Sonam & Ors. Vs. State of Bihar & Ors. reported in (2022) 6 SCC 599
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
In para-17 of the judgment, it is observed that:
"17. ..... this court has at numerous instances expressed concern over the misuse of section 498A IPC and the increased tendency of implicating relatives of the husband in matrimonial disputes, without analyzing the long term ramifications of a trial on the complainant as well as the accused.

It is further manifest from the said judgments that false implication by way of general omnibus allegations made in the course of matrimonial dispute, if left unchecked would result in misuse of the process of law.
Therefore, this court by way of its judgments has warned the courts from proceeding against the relatives and in- laws of the husband when no prima facie case is made out against them.".

11. In light of the settled principles and considering the peculiar facts and circumstances of the present case, the case is fully covered by the categories (1) and (7) as enumerated by the Apex Court in the case of State of Haryana Vs. Bhajan Lal reported in 1992 Suppl. (1) SCC 335.
12.

entities.text: State of Haryana Vs. Bhajan Lal reported in 1992 Suppl. (1) SCC 335

sentences.text: For the foregoing reasons, I hold that, if the criminal proceedings is allowed to continue, so far as present applicants ( in-laws) are concerned, then, it will nothing but sort of abuse of process of law and travesty of justice and it is a fit case wherein, the inherent powers needs to be exercised for the purpose of quashing of the FIR and proceedings of the criminal case as referred above.
Hence, the application is allowed.

13. The charge sheet dated 24.2.2023 as well as summoning order dated 13.04.2023 passed in Criminal Case No. 35217 of 2023 arising out of Case Crime No. 228 of 2022, under Sections 498A,
504, 323, 506 IPC and Section of D. P. Act, P.S. Chinhat, District Lucknow, pending in the court of learned ACJM, Court No. 27, Lucknow, are hereby quashed and set aside qua present applicants only.
